args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, SPF 30+)
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Rash guard/swim shirt (for sun protection)

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirts (for sun/insect protection)
- Small backpack/daypack
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent

LUAU & SPECIAL EVENTS:
- Hawaiian shirt or aloha wear
- Dress or nice outfit for luau
- Comfortable but presentable footwear

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Medications
- First aid kit
- Lip balm with SPF

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Books or e-reader
- Travel guidebook
- Umbrella or light rain jacket
- Reusable shopping bags
- Snacks for travel days

REMEMBER:
- Check luggage weight restrictions
- Leave room in suitcase for souvenirs
- Make digital copies of important documents
